description: Defines the AppManagerImplementation class which manages application lifecycle, installation, and configuration within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. Contains enums, structs, class declarations, and method signatures related to app management.

classes.name: AppManagerImplementation
classes.description: Implements application management, lifecycle, and configuration interfaces for the plugin.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Represents asynchronous tasks dispatched within the app manager.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for app manager events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification callback.

methods.name: LaunchApp
methods.description: Launches an application with specified ID, intent, and arguments.

methods.name: CloseApp
methods.description: Closes the application with the given ID.

methods.name: TerminateApp
methods.description: Terminates the application with the given ID.

methods.name: KillApp
methods.description: Forcefully kills the application with the given ID.

methods.name: GetLoadedApps
methods.description: Retrieves information about currently loaded applications.

methods.name: SendIntent
methods.description: Sends an intent to the specified application.

methods.name: PreloadApp
methods.description: Preloads an application with given arguments.

methods.name: GetAppProperty
methods.description: Gets a property value of an application.

methods.name: SetAppProperty
methods.description: Sets a property value for an application.

methods.name: GetInstalledApps
methods.description: Retrieves a list of installed applications.

methods.name: IsInstalled
methods.description: Checks if an application is installed.

methods.name: StartSystemApp
methods.description: Starts a system application.

methods.name: StopSystemApp
methods.description: Stops a system application.

methods.name: ClearAppData
methods.description: Clears data for a specific app.

methods.name: ClearAllAppData
methods.description: Clears data for all apps.

methods.name: GetAppMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for an app.

methods.name: GetMaxRunningApps
methods.description: Gets maximum number of concurrently running apps.

methods.name: GetMaxHibernatedApps
methods.description: Gets maximum number of hibernated apps.

methods.name: GetMaxHibernatedFlashUsage
methods.description: Gets maximum flash usage for hibernated apps.

methods.name: GetMaxInactiveRamUsage
methods.description: Gets maximum inactive RAM usage.
